title: The Nine as a psychological warfare experiment

tellings.quote: start around that time, too, with this idea that it was a side op, or that it was this early psychological warfare experiment where can we get,

plain: The Nine, a supposed council of alien intelligences said to have been contacted in the 1950s at the Round Table Foundation, a research group in Maine, may have been a side operation or an early psychological warfare experiment, according to the researcher Greg Malatzi. He tells Michels this without naming a firm source, drawing on the author Peter Levenda. If so, the contacts would have been a test of how far people could be led to believe, not messages from anywhere else.
